posts.author: fuglyjeans
posts.body:
Yo so I'm so excited to be here, my names Hannah! I'm 29 and live with my gf in the US.
I used to mess around with RPG Maker 2000 and 2003 way back when I was about 7-9 years old. I always wanted to return to it throughout my life as I got ideas for games but never got around to it until now. currently starting small to refresh my memory and learn the basics of serious game design.
My fave games back then were Romancing Walker and RM2K Survivor - NYSE. My fave games and biggest influences overall are Zelda, Paper Mario, The Sims 2 and Stardew Valley.
My biggest challenge when i get around to making my dream game is the background music.. I'm not musical at all. But I do have a fine arts degree in Illustration, so I'm hyped to make some pixel art and other visual assets.
Anyway I'm slacking off at work but I just wanted to say hi!!
